programme.title: Dylan's Playtime Adventures
programme.desc: Magician. Dylan the magician wants to do the biggest magic trick ever, but when he makes everyone disappear, he has to figure out how to bring them all back!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Flowery Island. While Kiri is playing with Rockaroonie, Lou sees an island in the middle of the lake that's completely covered in flowers. How can he get there?

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Popcorn. A young Cornasaurolophus starts popping, which draws the attention of the Bananaraptors!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Yoga Ball. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The List Badge. Duggee's lost his list for the day's activities at Squirrel Club.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: What a Hiccup! A case of never-ending hiccups puts the fun on hold for the Game Catchers.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Timmy's New Friend. Yabba is hurt when Timmy rejects her offers of friendship and snubs her in favour of his imaginary friend.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Amanpreet Goes Biking. Super speedy Amanpreet challenges her sister Amrit to a race around a muddy bike track. But who will win? And will they ever wash off all that mud?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Valentina's Greek Vegetarian Moussaka. Valentina shows us how to make a tasty Greek meal. Her moussaka recipe is loaded with fresh vegetables and topped with green lentils.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures with Chantelle and Rory
programme.desc: Moths. Chantelle sees one of the biggest moths while Rory and Sandy are spies in disguise.

programme.title: What's on Your Head?
programme.desc: Hijab. Sharmin, who is a Muslim, tells us all about her hijab and why she chose to wear one.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: Miss Gerrard's Birthday. It's Miss Gerrard's birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: Home Machines. Series for young children that celebrates many different kinds of amazing machines. In this episode, Grace shows off three extraordinary machines that you can actually live in.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Gloves. Dee encourages a friend to say 'gloves', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! We see gold gloves, spotty gloves, kitten mitten gloves and help Dee find her other glove.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Peekaboo! Children's animation. The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller. Learn about comparing numbers.

programme.title: Alphablocks

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Step by Stepping Stone. The Moving Crew, Go and Stop help Arty and the Little Hoppers figure out the right way to hop across the stepping stones to reach the other side of the muddy stream.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: A Plate of Many Colours. It's lunchtime in Colourland! Red invites her friends for lunch, where they try each other's favourite foods.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Hat Badge. Duggee and the Squirrels introduce King Tiger to lots of different hats and explain what they might be good for. But none of them feels right to him.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Snowbiz. It's been snowing, and Yukee and her garden friends use music and beat to build a big snow band.

programme.desc: Waffle and the Tooth Fairy. Preschool comedy drama series. Doug's tooth has fallen out, so Jess and Simon tell Waffle about the Tooth Fairy.

programme.title: Bluey
